note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Enniskillen rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There were no contests in the district; the Fermanagh Herald prints the nominations, five of them new members. Aghnaglack: no nomination; 'the outgoing member, Mr. Michael Lilley ... will be returned if he consents' (Fermanagh Herald, 21 May 1949, p. 3). He did not take the seat: the Returning Officer's notice of result of election for the Aughnaglack division declared Thomas Boylan duly elected, dated 2 August 1949 (Fermanagh Herald, 6 August 1949, p. 2), and Michael Lilley is styled 'ex-R.D.C.' in October 1949 (Fermanagh Herald, 8 October 1949, p. 8). Boylan's return is a by-election to fill the casual vacancy, not this round's result. Returned unopposed.
